packageRules.description: Auto-merge minor/patch PRs when CI passes (7-day wait, stricter than the 3-day default)
Auto-open PRs for major updates; review manually

TypeScript 7 breaks collection-reviewer-web's Next.js build (Next fails to detect TypeScript, build worker crashes with "The id argument must be of type string") - CI doesn't cover this subproject so this won't show as a failing check, hold off until Next.js/TS7 compatibility is confirmed manually
AWS's own Swift Lambda packages tend to release in lockstep; keep them in one PR

swift-async-algorithms is pinned to >=1.1.4 in Package.swift to work around a region-isolation build failure with newer Swift compilers (see the comment there) — require manual review on every update, not just majors

customManagers.description: Track the Swift base image pinned in scripts/build.sh — still the real build path, since the SAM Makefile's build-NZImageApiFunction target calls this script
